findings.finding: The release will carry Bakkafrost's FIRST 2027 harvest guidance, a scheduled guidance event. 2026 smolt transfers (FO 20.0m at 440g vs 18.7m at 453g in 2025; SCT 10.0m at 179g vs 7.3m at 154g) point to a year-on-year volume increase, mostly in Scotland.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 reports that carried the next-year guide moved -3.65% (2023-11-07), -2.94% (2024-11-05) and +4.34% (2025-11-04, when the Faroese guide was lifted but Scotland was cut)
findings.why_not_priced: Only the direction is inferable, and analysts have the same public smolt table, so consensus 2027 volume already reflects a rise. The unpriced part is the level against that consensus, and Scotland's record of cutting guides (cut in Q3 2025, mortality again in Q3 2026) makes the sign of the surprise genuinely open. A 20d run-up of +4.5% (mostly the Mowi read) does not look like an anticipated large raise.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 report shows the next-year guide is given in the Q3 report (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=658633); Pareto and Arctic raised 2027 salmon price estimates (https://ilaks.no/arctic-securities-tror-mowi-slakter-vesentlig-mer-laks-enn-guidet-for-tredje-kvartal/)

findings.finding: Faroese harvest is running ahead of the 2026 profile: Q3 was 23.1kt against 22% x 97kt = 21.3kt and YTD is 75.0kt, so only 22.0kt is needed in Q4 against a 23.3kt profile. That leaves room for a small lift to the FO 2026 guide. Scotland YTD is 13.9kt and needs 6.1kt against a 6.8kt Q4 profile.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 report raised FO 2026 from 92kt to 97kt and beat EBIT; the stock moved +0.62% (2026-05-19)
findings.why_not_priced: Volumes are public and the arithmetic is simple, so this is mostly priced. Only a formal raise would add anything, and with one quarter left it is small money.

findings.finding: Peer read: Mowi's preliminary Q3 2026 beat the analyst EBIT estimate by 27% (EUR 275m vs 216m) on record volumes, a farming cost 0.31 EUR/kg lower and no significant disease-related harvests. That supports a sector-wide cost and biology tailwind in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bakkafrost +2.7% on 2026-10-19 and +1.9% on 10-20 alongside Mowi +3.5%
findings.original_quote: Analytikerne som dekker selskapet hadde på forhånd estimert et driftsresultat på 216 millioner euro (Translation: analysts covering the company had estimated operating EBIT of EUR 216m)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Bakkafrost rose about 4.6% over the two sessions after. The transmission is macro to company, and Bakkafrost's own Faroese biology was already shown in its trading update, so what remains is small.

findings.finding: Feed raw-material inflation is a 2027 cost risk specific to Bakkafrost. Danske Bank downgraded to sell because Bakkafrost uses nearly twice the industry average of marine ingredients. The company says its fishmeal inventory covers feed production only into Q2 2027, so the 2027 cost outlook in this release is a likely negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not isolated; the Q2 2026 report flagged 'exceptional inflation in feed raw material costs' on a day the stock fell 8.4%, alongside a large EBIT miss
findings.original_quote: selskapet bruker nesten det dobbelte av industrigjennomsnittet av marine ingredienser og har ikke stort nok lager til å vente ut prisøkningene (Translation: the company uses nearly double the industry average of marine ingredients and does not have a large enough inventory to wait out the price rises)
findings.why_not_priced: The risk is well known (a public sell note since April), so the level is priced. What is unpriced is the size the company puts on 2027 feed cost. Partly offset by FOF, which captures some of the margin internally (FOF margin 20% in Q2).
findings.independence: Arctic Securities estimates feed alone lifts salmon production cost by about NOK 5/kg (https://ilaks.no/arctic-securities-venter-forsjokk-men-ogsa-en-mulig-ubalanse-for-lakseprisen/); company statement on inventory into Q2 2027 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=681223)

Q3 again carries Scottish exceptional mortality (DKK 42m) and 3.0kg harvest weights.

baseline_tension: Neutral. The lean (-0.22) is just the run-up, and the findings net to about zero: a likely higher 2027 volume guide against 2027 feed cost and Scotland's record of missing.
language_note: ilaks.no (Norwegian) framed the routine 5 Oct Q3 trading update as a 'resultatvarsel' (profit warning) on Scotland; the English filing is titled 'Trading Update'. The facts are identical, so this is framing only.

Norwegian press (ilaks/TDN Direkt/Finansavisen) carried broker targets and the Danske Bank feed-cost sell note in more detail than the English wires, including Arctic Securities' 542 and Pareto's 510 Buy targets. All of it was public and none was a new company number.
The filings themselves are English-only on NewsWeb, so the Norwegian-language sources added no company-level fact the English ones did not.
lessons_applied: 'A first guide for a new fiscal year is a scheduled guidance event' (median 9.0% when guidance changes): abs_move_pct raised from 4.0 to 5.5. Not to 9, because the period's volumes are pre-released and this is a 9-analyst name with a 2.05% median reaction
Guidance findings went 11/17 on sign: the 2027-guide finding raised from +0.8 to +1.0
Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis: the Mowi peer read was cut from +0.3 to +0.2 because Bakkafrost already moved +4.6% on it
Reaction history moves p_up, not size; bar unsourced: the serial-miss finding was cut from -0.8 to -0.6 and p_up kept at 50
